assumptions: Column names differing only in case/whitespace are the same species and were summed.
issues: Duplicate taxon columns (Globigerinoides ruber, Neogloboquadrina incompta, Globorotalia inflata) due to capitalisation/spacing merged: 11 columns -> 8 species.
summary: Normalised taxon names, summed duplicate columns, counted species with nonzero total, computed mean pairwise Bray-Curtis on raw counts over all sample pairs.
